title: docs: a default or create form an action opens by name is not reported; two checklist items re-audited
body:

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuKGddwBcChMgB9UWGoWTjCr)_

Part of #36798

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：读文档的应用作者不再被告知「默认表单和新建表单一律会被检查报出」；动作按名字打开的那一张不报，并且照常加载。两条内部测试项改成去仍然加载表单的页面上测。
- 为什么做：检查规则三天前已经改了，两页文档没跟上，作者可能据此删掉一张还在用的表单；两条测试项写的做法已经测不到任何东西。
- 出错会怎样：只改文档和内部测试清单，不改产品行为；写错了读者会被误导，撤回这次合并即可恢复原文。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

Docs, two sentences:

- `content/docs/ui/views.mdx`, "Form View": a non-public `form`, `formViews.default` or `formViews.create` is reported as `form-view-internal-not-loaded`, except one that a form action opens by name. That one still loads where the action opens it. The action's `target` must be the form's served name written out; an interpolated target names no form.
- `content/docs/ui/create-vs-edit-form.mdx`, "Recommended solution": the same exception, in one sentence.

Both follow the rule as merged in PR #36793: `validateInternalFormViews` in `packages/lint/src/validate-internal-form-views.ts` skips a site whose served name equals the literal target of a `type: 'form'` action.

Checklist, two items re-audited (the card asks for this under the checklist-author skill). Both carried a STALE marker from PR #36793 and no usable recipe.

- `records-forms.form-view-gallery`, revision 9 to 10. The layouts move from a default-form overlay on the record form routes to the named-form page (`/forms/NAME`, `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`). That page is the one console surface that still loads a form view. Each layout is walked at its own served name: `showcase_task.form`, `showcase_task.tabbed`, `showcase_task.wizard`. The overlay recipe stays only for the retired-type refusal step, as a new third `fixtures.requires` entry, so no existing index moves. A new negative says a layout scored off a record create or edit surface is a method failure.
- `studio-authoring.no-entry-property-matrix`, revision 10 to 11, the `view.form` row. Its observable is the named-form page. `submitBehavior`, `allowSkip`, `showStepIndicator`, `buttons` and `defaults` are read there. `groups` is folded onto `sections` at parse. `subforms` and `modalSize` have no reader on a form view since the create and edit forms stopped loading one, so they move into `fixtures.knownGaps[0]` as failing rows, and `defaults` moves out of it.

What this pull request leaves of the card: the `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md` sentence, which the card splits into its own pull request because `skills/**` is a governed surface. That is #37544. Both are `Part of` so that neither closes the card before the other lands.

## Tests

`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` at 886ab70d: exit 0, `check-platform-checklist: OK — 16 areas, 448 items (437 active, 5 planned)`, symbol anchors 1805/1815 resolved, the same 10 on the named residual as before the edit.

No code changes, so no unit test moves.

## Acceptance notes

- Read first: (1) the `records-forms.form-view-gallery` hunk in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json`, the largest change; (2) the `view.form` row and `knownGaps[0]` in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json`, which now scores two keys as failing; (3) the two `.mdx` sentences.
- The re-audit is a source read at base 5dbcc02b, not a run. Both history entries say so, and `form-view-gallery` records it as `knownGaps[3]`. No app was booted and no browser was driven. The first run of either item may correct a step.
- `form-view-gallery` acceptance clause 3 loses its width half ("full-width via span 'full'"). The named-form page takes a field's width from `colSpan` alone and does not read `span`, so the clause would score a width the page is not built to draw. Recorded as `knownGaps[2]` and reported to the seat for its own card.
- `subforms` on a form view: the named-form page does not name the key, and `recordFormSubforms` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/recordFormNavigation.ts` takes child collections from the object alone. Its ledger entry in `packages/spec/liveness/view.json` still reads live, by the React form block. Reported to the seat as a sibling of the `modalSize` re-audit card #36544, not ruled here.
- `skip-changeset`: the diff is `content/docs/**` and `docs/qa/**`. Neither is in any package's published files.
- The two declaration lines above are copied from the card's claim comment 7192305558.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` exits 0 and prints the OK line above.

Exit 0: `check-adr-links`, `check-closing-keyword-parity`, `check-comment-mask-corpus`, `check-doc-route-spelling --advisory`, `check-docs-section-name`, `check-section-landing-index` (each with its self-test where it has one), `plan-test-core-shards --self-test`, `check:empty-state`, `check:liveness`, `check:strictness-ledger`, `check:variant-docs`, `check:yaml-examples`, `check:adr-anchors`, `check:ci-filter-parity`, `check:closed-ceremony-text`, `check:corpus-claim-drift`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:doc-anchors`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:doc-frontmatter`, `check:docs-audit-scope`, `check:docs-redirects`, `check:docs-single-h1`, `check:docs-spec-enumerations`, `check:driver-memory-census`, `check:gitlink-declared`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:platform-checklist`, `check:pm-expected-skips`, `check:published-readme-links`, `check:react-page-adapter-contract`, `check:refd-timer-probe`, `check:role-word`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:vendor-version-stamps`, `check:watch-hint-literal`.

Exit 3: `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:doc-security-posture`, `check:skill-examples`, `check:docs-transcript-drift`. Exit 1 with the text "Generate it first: gen:schema": `check:docs` of the spec package, which refuses without the generated schema tree and judged nothing.
